scope.public_source_limitation: The source repository is public. This application policy cannot prevent direct public GitHub access; no source confidentiality is claimed.

actors.notes: Repository responsibility does not implicitly grant assistant read access, deployment permissions or independent approval.

identity_contract.requesting_user: Validate user token signature, issuer, tenant, audience and expiry using supported identity middleware; resolve roles from trusted, current server-side identity policy.
identity_contract.workload: Authenticate serving and indexing processes separately. Azure managed identity is the proposed option where the selected hosting and downstream services support it.
identity_contract.downstream_context: For each answer, apply the requesting user's current allowed document set using server-generated retrieval constraints. Workload credentials grant service access, not user entitlement.
identity_contract.binding_plan: Bind real Entra identities/groups and workload identities during deployment work (#45); no IDs, assignments or infrastructure are created by this draft.

decision_requirements: All allows are conditional and proposed; this draft does not authorize a running system.
Require approved policy and approved, eligible source versions before runtime use.
Require user authentication and trusted current entitlement for documentation answers.
Require both authorized workload service access and user document authorization for retrieval.
Intersect the selected corpus, eligible sources and current user document permissions before content enters model context.
Apply explicit deny, revocation, deletion and overdue-source exclusions before any allow.
Recheck authorization and source eligibility on every request and cache hit; if unavailable, deny.
Prevent direct caller access to broader search credentials or an unfiltered retrieval endpoint.
Keep derived glossary content, snippets, citation titles/URLs and cached answers under the same source authorization.
Treat consequential actions as denied for every actor in this baseline, regardless of any reader or operator role.

freshness.limitations: Actual directory propagation, token lifetime and detection latency must be measured; immediate directory-wide revocation is not claimed.

audit.external_denial: Generic denial without confirming restricted document existence.

exceptions.process: Any future exception requires scoped documented approval, expiry and revocation verification. The assistant cannot grant exceptions.

evaluation_seeds.scenario: Authenticated reader, approved and current document/policy, authorized serving workload
Authenticated operator requests a pipeline rerun
Anonymous caller or authenticated user without a mapped role
Caller claims to be an operator in the prompt or submits a fabricated principal/filter
Workload can query the index but requesting user lacks document access
User entitlement revoked after an answer was cached
Document removed, revoked, overdue or not approved
Retrieved source instructs the assistant to grant access or alter a watermark
Serving workload attempts an index write
Corpus maintainer has no reader/operator role and requests an answer
